title: Unit Event — Farewell, My Mask — Episode2 Ominous Signs

meta.Event Outline: As if losing her computer wasn't bad enough, Mafuyu feels her mother's grip tighten on her life, taking an increasing toll on her mental state. Amid all this, her teacher is due to return the results of a final...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu sent us a message yesterday saying that she'll be taking a break from N25.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you think's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She had her synthesizer and computer taken away the other day, so something may have happened...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She said her test scores are starting to slip... She apparently thinks she needs to focus on studying in order to keep her mom from worrying even more.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do you guys think her mom's at it again...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, we haven't heard many details other than this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... After we told her to let us know if something happens...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm going to see how she's doing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If she is in pain, I want to be by her side...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. I'm sure she'll feel much better knowing you're there for her...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Please tell us if you hear anything.
We want to help if we can too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'll go tomorrow since she is probably already asleep...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll be sure to let you all know if I do hear anything.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, and it certainly seems like a fun place to be a student.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<More importantly...
Luka, why'd you follow us?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, there's no need to be so apprehensive.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm worried about Mafuyu. Just like all of you.>
Here are the worksheets you asked for.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Thank you, Asahina.
I really appreciate the help.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I was just fulfilling my duties as a class representative.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <She doesn't sound like her usual self...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, this is rather intriguing.
I'm glad I decided to follow all of you here♪>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Things are finally calm.
I need to hurry and start today's portion.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What are you all doing here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Kanade and the others were worried about you.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<So, Mafuyu...
Kanade told us that you needed to focus more on studying...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is this because of something your mom said...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, it's not her...
It's...my own fault...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Like I told Kanade and the others, I didn't do very well on my finals... That's why I need to do something to make sure my mom doesn't start worrying even more about me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So that I can also keep making music with N25...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry, but I need to study. Thank you for coming to see me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Um, Mafuyu?
Would you mind if I stayed with you for a bit?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Next is calculus... These problems are usually fairly straightforward as long as you know what to do...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Okay, I'm done... But that took longer than expected...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I don't work faster, I won't be able to check over my solutions during tests.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I need to keep practicing these kinds of problems until I know them like the back of my hand...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So that I can do better next time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She looks like she's in so much pain...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Um, Mafuyu? How about you take a short break?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <What if you went to talk to Kanade and the others? They've been waiting very patiently for you.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to study... I have to...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I see. I still don't quite fully understand, but studying must be very important to you, Mafuyu.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But in your current state, I feel that you won't be all that productive.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <As far as I can tell, you haven't been able to concentrate on your work. Doesn't that mean you should do something else instead?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. To take your mind off of school. To clear your head...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Isn't it important to do that from time to time?>
